status: historical Sprint 8 frozen candidate; EXPERIMENTAL, not validated on hardware

decision.rule: probs = softmax(logits / temperature); pred = argmax over 11 classes; reject (unknown) if max(probs) < threshold

modes.clean: load_audio -> preprocess_waveform (no band-pass, no enhancement). Matches training clean path and predict.predict_file.
modes.laser: load_audio -> Butterworth order-4 zero-phase band-pass 200-3800 Hz -> enhance_waveform -> preprocess_waveform. Matches the training 'sim' path and the dashboard laser channel default (LMML_LASER_BANDPASS=200,3800). predict.predict_file does NOT do this for laser recordings.

filter_setting: ENABLE_FILTER=False (reduce_noise off) for Sprint 8 training and replay; the predictor pins this.
dependencies: Python 3.10+, torch, torchaudio, numpy, scipy, soundfile. Uses the repository's src/ and scripts/sprint8/ modules (repo-relative; no /home/claude paths).
intended_use: Development demo and offline scoring of development WAVs. Not for deployment decisions; no real-rig accuracy is claimed.
